description.zh:
是否全部删除。只针对**Tagkeys**为空时有效。取值范围：
- true：全部删除。
- false：不全部删除。

默认值：false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags. This parameter is valid only when the **Tagkeys** is empty. Valid values:

*   true: All the data is deleted.
*   false: Not all of them are deleted.

Default value: false
The ID of the region in which you want to create the instance.
The type of the resource. Set the value to cluster.

description.zh: 标签key值。数组元数个数N的取值范围：1~20。
description.en: The key of the label. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun emr untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type cluster --resource-ids c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --tag-keys Department --all false --region cn-hangzhou
